notes.title: Release 1.2
notes.notes:
The lair now contains 4 characters slots.
The progess of each character will be stored between runs until the character either dies or is reset manually.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
- Added random spawned materials and increased other material drops
- Increased material cost of upgrades
- elite monster added to earlier isles.
- 4 steam achievements added

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes: Added option for the game to run in windowed mode.
